portfolio.title: Portfolio
lossHarvest.title: Offset losses in {year}
lossHarvest.summary: You have {gains} of gains from sales this year. Selling positions at a loss could save up to {max} of income tax.
lossHarvest.recentBuyHint: You bought in the last 2 months ({dates}): under the two-month rule that part of the loss would not offset now.
lossHarvest.pick: Tick the ones you would sell anyway to see the combined saving: it does not simply add up, because the offset has a limit.
lossHarvest.caution: Only worth it for shares you would sell anyway. If you buy the same one again before {date}, the loss does not offset this year.
saleSim.title: Simulate selling {name}
saleSim.description: Which lots would go out and what you would declare. Nothing is recorded.
saleSim.invalid: Enter a quantity between 0 and {qty} and a sale price.
saleSim.error: The sale could not be simulated. Try again.
saleSim.costBasis: Tax cost of what is sold
saleSim.taxSale: Estimated income tax of this sale
saleSim.carriedForward: {amount} carried forward to the next 4 years
saleSim.noSaving: It saves no tax this year: you have no gains, dividends or interests to offset. The loss is carried forward to the next 4 years.
saleSim.notSalary: A loss on a sale only offsets gains, dividends and interests; it never lowers the tax on your salary.
saleSim.taxContext: Counting {year} so far: gains from sales {gains} and dividends and interests {income}.
saleSim.washRecent: It is a loss and you bought this security in the last 2 months ({dates}). Under the two-month rule the repurchased part cannot be offset now: it is deferred until you sell those shares.
saleSim.washRebuy: It is a loss: if you buy this security again before {date}, it cannot be offset now (two-month rule).
saleSim.lotDetail: You sell {sold} of {held} · cost {cost} per share
saleSim.disclaimerTax: Indicative simulation: nothing is recorded. The tax ignores losses from earlier years and anything outside Fintrack.
portfolio.annualHint: What your money in this position has earned per year, counting when you bought and the dividends.
returns.noData: There are no operations to calculate it yet.
returns.title: Returns
returns.explain: What your money has earned per year, taking into account when each euro went in and out (IRR). Compared with putting the same money into an index fund on the same days.
returns.benchmarkUnavailable: Index prices could not be downloaded. Try again later.
returns.notReliable: Less than a year of history: the annual figure is only indicative.
returns.startsLate: Some operations predate the {name} fund; they were valued at its first price.
returns.indexNote: Index: accumulating ETF {ticker}, price of {date}. The fund's fees are already in its price.
returns.chartNote: Your portfolio includes the dividends you collected, because the index fund reinvests its own. Put in is what you invested minus what you took out with sales. Your line starts with the first saved portfolio snapshot.
history.title: Portfolio history
history.desc: Fintrack photographs your portfolio from the day it started doing so. It can rebuild the earlier days from your operations and Yahoo closing prices. It only fills days without a snapshot; the ones you have are left as they are.
history.nothing: No day is missing: the history is complete.
history.willCreate: {count} snapshots would be added, from {from} to {to}.
history.noYahoo: No Yahoo prices, valued at the price of their last operation: {names}.
history.purged: The automatic cleanup deletes snapshots older than {date}, rebuilt ones too. Check it above if you want to keep them.
history.effects: They show in the equity chart, the index comparison and the net worth evolution, which for those months will show the value of your investments instead of their cost.
history.failed: The history could not be rebuilt. Try again later.
assets.title: Assets
assets.deleteError: Cannot delete asset because it has transactions or dividends linked to it.

accounts.deleteError: Cannot delete account because it has transactions, snapshots, or interests linked to it.
accounts.monthlySnapshotDesc: Update the balance of all accounts

transactions.searchAsset: Type to search for an asset…
transactions.taxesTooltip: FTT / stamp duty / market fees by country
transactions.taxNote: Capital gains tax is calculated in the Tax section, not here.
dividends.title: Dividends
dividends.domesticWithholdingHelp: Withheld by a bank or broker in your country of residence (in Spain, 19%). It is declared as a withholding, not as double taxation.
interests.title: Interests
savings.title: Savings
savings.subtitle: Month-by-month cash flow
savings.noSnapshots: No cash snapshots yet. Add snapshots in the Accounts section to see the history.
savings.trimmedMeanHint: Trimmed mean: excludes best and worst month
savings.needMoreMonths: Need at least 6 months in range
savings.estimatedSpendingHelp: Income received between the previous snapshot and this month's (net pay, other income, dividends and interest) minus real savings. It is approximate: sales at a gain, loans or accounts without snapshots skew it.
savings.deleteGoalConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this goal?
savings.baseTypeHint.CASH: Only the cash in your accounts
savings.noGoals: No savings goals yet. Create your first goal to start tracking your progress.
savings.onTrackDetail: Based on your average savings, you'll reach this goal before the deadline.
savings.behindScheduleDetail: Based on your average savings, you won't make it in time. You need an extra {extra}/month to meet the deadline.
savings.behindScheduleGeneric: Based on your average savings, you won't make it in time.
interests.taxHelp: Amount withheld at source. Empty = not informed, will be inferred. Set 0 if you confirm there is no withholding.
interests.commissionHelp: Only if your broker charges them. They reduce the net received.
interests.netDefaultHint: Withholding not informed: assuming {rate}% Spanish IRPF to compute net. Edit manually if your case differs.
interests.mismatchWarning: Mismatch: gross − withholding − fees should be {expected} (difference {diff}).
dividends.commissionHelp: Only if your broker reports them. They reduce the net received.

fiscal.renta.header.title: Values ready to paste into the Spanish tax return · Year {year}
fiscal.renta.header.subtitle: Each highlighted amount is ready to paste into its corresponding box. Informative amounts are reference only and are not entered in the tax return.
fiscal.renta.header.legend.copy: To copy into the tax return

fiscal.renta.sales.totalsHint: These totals are NOT copied into the tax return. They are only for verifying your figures.
fiscal.renta.summary.salesHeader: SHARE SALES (control totals · declare line by line)
fiscal.renta.summary.salesControlNote: These amounts are NOT a declarable line. Each sale is declared individually in the sales block.
settings.title: Settings
settings.costMethodWarningPortfolio: Changing the portfolio cost method will affect how future snapshots calculate cost basis. Historical snapshots will not change, which may cause a discontinuity in evolution charts.
settings.costMethodWarningFiscal: All fiscal reports will be recalculated using the new method. If you already filed taxes using a different method, the app figures will no longer match your filings.
settings.taxCountryHelp: Your country of fiscal residence. The tax-return assistant (Modo Renta) is only available for Spain for now; entries marked with ✓ have an adapter.
settings.storageDesc: Total space used by the database.
settings.dataRetentionDesc: Automatically delete snapshots older than the selected period. Purge runs daily.
settings.purgePortfolioSnapshotsDesc: Aggregate portfolio snapshots (total value, cost, P&L)
settings.backupDesc: Export all your data to a JSON file. Importing a backup replaces all your current data with the file's.
settings.importBackupConfirm: All your current data (operations, dividends, payslips, accounts, history…) will be deleted and replaced with the backup's. If anything fails, nothing changes. Continue?
settings.tableTooltipAssetsAsset: Securities catalog: stocks, ETFs, funds, crypto. One row per asset.
settings.tableTooltipAssetsAccount: Cash accounts: operating, savings, investment, deposits, alternatives.
settings.tableTooltipAssetsAccountsnapsh: Account balance history. Used for patrimony evolution chart.
settings.tableTooltipAssetsSettings: Per-user settings: cost method, rounding, snapshot frequency.
settings.tableTooltipAssetsPortfoliosnap: Aggregate portfolio snapshot: total value, cost and unrealized P&L.
settings.tableTooltipAssetsPositionsnaps: Per-asset snapshot detail: quantity, cost, market value, P&L.
settings.tableTooltipTransactionsTransac: Buy/sell/gift operations. Feeds the cost basis engine (FIFO/LIFO/WAC).
settings.tableTooltipTransactionsDividen: Dividend payments: gross amount, withholding, net.
settings.tableTooltipTransactionsInteres: Interest income on accounts: gross, net, balance, annual rate.
settings.tableTooltipTransactionsStocksp: Stock splits and reverse splits: they adjust the quantity and unit cost of positions.

landing.heroSubtitle: Portfolio, transactions, dividends, interests, and taxes. All in one panel, with total privacy.
marketing.heroSubtitle: Portfolio, transactions, dividends, payslips and taxes in one panel, with an AI assistant that advises you on your real data. All with total privacy.
marketing.aiSubtitle: Connect Fintrack to your AI and ask about your investments, savings or payslips. It answers with your actual figures, knows your profile and helps you decide.
marketing.aiConnectDesc: MCP server included: use it with Claude or any compatible assistant, with a personal token you can revoke.
marketing.aiProfileDesc: It asks what it needs, builds your profile and financial plan and keeps them up to date with every decision.
marketing.aiAnalysisDesc: It analyses your portfolio, your real return against an index, how much you save and spend each month, your salary and your income tax.
marketing.aiSalesDesc: It simulates sales, estimates the tax and tells you which losses are worth offsetting before year end.
marketing.aiRecordsDesc: Operations, dividends, balances or income from a screenshot or a message, always with your confirmation.
marketing.aiHelpDesc: How each figure is calculated, what a number means or how to do something in the app.
marketing.aiChatUser: Would I save any tax by selling what I have at a loss?
marketing.aiChatAnswer1: You have €840 of gains from sales this year. Selling Acme and Beta (−€920 together) offsets those gains and part of your dividends: you would save about €165 of tax.
marketing.aiChatAnswer2: Only worth it if you would sell them anyway. And don't buy them back within 2 months, or you lose the offset.
marketing.aiChatAnswer3: A loss never lowers the tax on your salary, only on savings income.
marketing.aiPrivacy: Your data stays on your server: the AI only reads what it needs with your token, which can never delete anything.
marketing.featuresSubtitle: From transaction tracking to tax reports. No bloat, no missing features.
marketing.featurePortfolioDesc: View all your positions with prices updated via Yahoo Finance. FIFO, LIFO or weighted average cost.
marketing.featureTransactionsDesc: Record buys, sells and gifts. Commissions, taxes and notes included in every operation.
marketing.featureDividendsDesc: Detailed tracking of passive income with tax withholdings and net yield.
marketing.featureFiscalDesc: Generate your annual tax summary with realized gains, dividends and interests. Ready for filing.
marketing.featureEvolutionDesc: Charts showing your wealth evolution, broken down by investments, fixed income, equities and cash.
marketing.featureMultilangDesc: Interface in 5 languages. Support for EUR, USD, GBP and any currency. You choose.
marketing.featurePrivacyDesc: Your data never leaves your server. No tracking, no analytics, no third parties. Just you.
marketing.featureAccountsDesc: Manage checking, savings, investment, deposit and alternative accounts from one place.
marketing.featureSavingsDesc: Analyze your savings capacity month by month with detailed charts of income vs investment expenses.
marketing.step1Desc: One single docker compose up command and Fintrack is running on your server. PostgreSQL, Redis, backend and frontend ready.
marketing.step2Desc: Create your account, choose your base currency, cost method (FIFO/LIFO/WAC) and connect your assets with Yahoo Finance.
marketing.step3Desc: Add your transactions, dividends and interests. Import historical data from JSON or record day by day.
marketing.step4Desc: Check your portfolio, net worth evolution, per-asset performance and generate your tax report in one click.
marketing.openSourceDesc: Fintrack is 100% open source. Deploy on your own server with Docker Compose. No subscriptions, no limits, no data sent to third parties. Audit it, modify it, make it yours.

payroll.title: Payslips
payroll.analyticsEmpty: No payslips yet to show evolution.
payroll.analyticsBonusRatio: Bonus vs monthly base by year
payroll.mismatchWarning: Heads-up: gross − SS − tax − net = {delta}. This is expected when the payslip includes advances, garnishments, exempt allowances, in-kind compensation or other adjustments; you can save anyway.
payroll.pdfHelp: Experimental: upload your payslip PDF and we'll fill in the fields. Review the amounts before saving — the parser may fail on unusual templates or scanned documents.
payroll.pdfRecognized: PDF processed. Review the amounts before saving.
payroll.pdfNotRecognized: PDF not recognised as a Spanish payslip. Fill in the fields manually.
payroll.bulkSubtitle: Review each payslip before creating it. You can edit amounts, remove rows or change the employer.
payroll.bulkNoRowsReady: No rows ready to create. Fill in employer, gross and net.
payroll.bulkSomeFailed: Some payslips could not be created. Check the highlighted errors.
payroll.bulkDeleteConfirm: Delete {count} payslips? This action cannot be undone.
splits.title: Splits
splits.help: A split multiplies your shares and divides their unit cost without changing the total cost. Fintrack detects them automatically from Yahoo Finance; you can also record them manually.
splits.empty: No splits recorded for this asset.
splits.detectFound: New splits detected: {count}. Review and apply them.
splits.detectNone: No new splits for your assets.
splits.detectError: Could not reach Yahoo Finance. Try again later.
splits.pendingDescription: Some of your stocks had a split after you bought them. Until you apply it, the quantity and return of those positions will be wrong.
splits.ratioHelp: New shares : old shares. A 4:1 split turns 1 share into 4; a 1:10 reverse split turns 10 shares into 1.
splits.duplicateError: A split for this asset on that date already exists.
splits.confirmDelete: Delete this split? Quantities and costs will be recalculated without it.
splits.adjustedHint: Quantity recorded in the trade. The arrow shows the shares it represents today after later splits.
positionHistory.title: Position history
positionHistory.help: Your trades in this asset with the shares you held after each one.
positionHistory.helpWithSplits: Your trades and the splits of this asset, with the shares you held after each step, so you can reconcile the current quantity with your broker.
dividendDrafts.title: Dividends awaiting review ({count})
dividendDrafts.description: Drafts detected from Yahoo Finance. Check each one against your broker and save it; they don't count in reports or tax until you accept them.
dividendDrafts.confirmDismissAll: Dismiss all pending drafts? They won't be suggested again.
dividendDrafts.restoreHint: Makes it pending review again. Dismissed drafts are never proposed again on their own.
dividendDrafts.detectFound: New dividend drafts: {count}. Review and accept them.
dividendDrafts.detectError: Could not reach Yahoo Finance. Try again later.
dividendDrafts.fromYahoo: Detected on Yahoo: ex-dividend on {date}, {shares} shares × {amount} ≈ {gross} gross.
dividendDrafts.checkWithTax: Withholding is estimated from your previous dividends. Check the payment date, net amount and withholding with your broker; Yahoo amounts are in the quote currency.
dividendDrafts.checkNoTax: There are no previous dividends to estimate withholding. Check the payment date, net amount and withholding with your broker; Yahoo amounts are in the quote currency.
dividendDrafts.assetCardHelp: The daily search only suggests dividends after the last one you recorded. This button searches Yahoo for every dividend of this asset since your first purchase that you don't have yet.
aiAccess.title: AI access (MCP)
aiAccess.description: Connect an AI assistant (Claude Desktop or Claude Code) to your Fintrack so it can look up and analyse your data. It runs on your computer and calls Fintrack over your local network with a token you can revoke at any time.
aiAccess.confirmRevoke: Revoke this token? The assistant using it will lose access.
aiAccess.keyOnce: Copy the token now: it won't be shown again.
aiAccess.backendUrlHelp: Address your computer uses to reach the Fintrack backend (port 8001 by default). It must be listed in the server's ALLOWED_HOSTS.
aiAccess.urlInvalid: The URL must start with http:// or https://
aiAccess.unreachable: Not reachable from this browser. Check the address, port or certificate, and that the backend is published.
aiAccess.suggestedUrl: Automatic suggestion: this site's address on port 8001. If you use a reverse proxy, enter the backend address here, test it and save it; the commands below will use it.
aiAccess.uvHelp: You need uv installed (brew install uv). After adding the configuration, restart Claude Desktop or open a new Claude Code session.
aiAccess.desktopPathHelp: Claude Desktop doesn't see your terminal's PATH, so it uses the full path to uvx. If you didn't install uv with Homebrew on an Apple Silicon Mac, replace it with the output of "which uvx".
aiAccess.name: Name
aiAccess.scopeReadHelp: The assistant can look up your portfolio, operations, dividends, interests and reports. It can't change anything.
aiAccess.scopeWriteHelp: It can also add operations, dividends, interests, other income and rent payments and expenses, accept drafts, apply splits, add or edit assets and record your account balances. It can never delete data or change your account, and your AI client asks for confirmation before each write.
otherIncome.title: Other income
otherIncome.subtitle: Money you receive outside payslips, dividends and interest: rent, side jobs, gifts… It counts towards your savings and estimated spending.
otherIncome.repeatLastHelp: New income with the details of the last one: just change the date and amount.
rental.intro: Manage your rentals: leases, payments and expenses, and see what they yield and how they are taxed, up to today and projected for the year.
rental.noProperties: Add a property in the Properties tab first.
rental.taxDataHelp: Used for depreciation (3 % a year of the building) and the imputation of empty days. You will find them on the property tax bill and the deed.
rental.taxDataMissing: Data missing to compute depreciation (purchase price and total and building cadastral value).
rental.cadastralConstructionHelp: Without the land: land is not depreciated.
rental.cadastralRevised: Cadastral value revised since 1994 (1.1 % imputation instead of 2 %)
rental.reductionHelp: Applies to a positive net rent when it is the tenant's main home. Contracts before 26/05/2023: 60 %.
rental.reduction.YOUNG: Stressed area, young tenant or social housing (70 %)
rental.reduction.NONE: No reduction (not the tenant's main home)
rental.rentedShareHelp: 100 % if you rent the whole home; less for a room.
rental.paymentHelp: It is also saved in Other income, so it counts in your savings.
rental.needLease: Create a lease to record payments.
rental.expense.TAXES.help: Property tax, waste and other local taxes. Prorated by the days rented.
rental.expense.COMMUNITY.help: Owners' association fees. Prorated by the days rented.
rental.expense.INSURANCE.help: Home, non-payment or liability insurance. Prorated by the days rented.
rental.expense.REPAIRS.help: Painting, plumbing, replacing appliances… Together with interest, deductible up to the income; the excess carries forward 4 years.
rental.expense.FINANCING.help: If recorded, it replaces the interest computed from this property's mortgage (use the bank certificate).
rental.expense.UTILITIES.help: Electricity, water, gas or internet you pay as the owner.
rental.expense.SERVICES.help: Rental management, agency, contract fees, lawyers.
rental.expense.IMPROVEMENT.help: Works that add value (new kitchen, extension). Not a yearly expense: added to the depreciation base.
rental.expense.OTHER.help: Other costs needed for the rental (e.g. bad debts).
rental.taxOnlySpain: The rental tax calculation is only available with Spain as fiscal residence (Settings).
rental.noLeaseThisYear: This property has no lease in {year}.
rental.taxResultHelp: Rental income for tax with your recorded payments and expenses.
rental.estimatedFields: Estimated in the projection: {fields} (rent still due from the lease, last year's costs, mortgage interest).
rental.result.excess: Interest and repairs above the income: {amount}, to offset in the next 4 years.
rental.simulatorHelp: Change any figure (rent, costs, reduction…) and see the effect. Nothing is saved.
rental.simulateError: Could not compute with those figures.
rental.disclaimer: Rough estimate: income tax uses an approximate general scale (state + regional) on top of your payslip base ({base}); each region has its own. It does not include excess interest and repairs from earlier years unless you enter it in the simulator. Check with your advisor or the Renta Web draft.
fiscal.renta.rental.title: Rental income (real estate capital)
fiscal.renta.rental.excess: Excess to offset in the next 4 years
fiscal.renta.rental.help: From the payments and expenses recorded in Properties → Rental. Check the property tax data and the simulator there.
